raw_snippet: In June 2026, we announced a six-year strategic compute collaboration with NVIDIA pursuant to a Master Cloud Services Agreement and Order Form 1 dated June 8, 2026 (the “NVIDIA Agreement”), which has a contract value of up to $4.88 billion
note: Nvidia -> Sharon AI six-year cloud-services agreement (Nvidia as customer or backstop buyer) for a 72 MW, up to 40,000 GB300 build in Australia; counted at face as "up to". The June 12 announcement had no dollar value; the Sharon AI Form S-1 of 31 Jul 2026 is the first filing to state it.
